IDS20201
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology
South Australia

Marine Wind Warning Summary for South Australia
Issued at 9:30 am CDT on Wednesday 4 November 2026
for the period until midnight CDT Wednesday 4 November 2026.

Wind Warnings for Wednesday 4 November
Strong Wind Warning for the following areas:
Central Coast, South Central Coast, Spencer Gulf, Gulf St Vincent, Investigator
Strait, Upper South East Coast and Lower South East Coast

The next marine wind warning summary will be issued by 3:30 pm CDT Wednesday.

================================================================================
Check the latest Coastal Waters Forecast or Local Waters Forecast at
http://www.bom.gov.au/sa/forecasts/map.shtml for information on wind, wave and
weather conditions for these coastal zones.
